entries.name: AA12
entries.description: A fully automatic shotgun fed from a box magazine.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: AK47
entries.description: A select-fire rifle. The fire mode key switches between automatic and semi-automatic.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Anzio20mm
entries.description: The largest rifle here: a bolt-action 20mm with a three-round magazine. Heavy enough to slow you right down.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: ArmselStriker
entries.description: A shotgun with a twelve-round drum. It fires as fast as you pull the trigger and reloads a shell at a time.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: AUGA3
entries.description: A bullpup rifle: a long barrel in a short weapon. It has its own foregrip.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: BarrettM99
entries.description: A single-shot .50 calibre rifle: one round, then a reload.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: ChiappaRhino
entries.description: A revolver that fires from the bottom chamber, so it kicks less than it should. Six rounds, loaded one at a time.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: DesertEagle
entries.description: A heavy semi-automatic pistol: few rounds, a lot of kick, a lot of damage.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: FNFAL
entries.description: A battle rifle: a heavy round that goes through cover, and kick to match.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: G36C
entries.description: A select-fire rifle. The fire mode key switches between automatic, burst and semi-automatic.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Glock17
entries.description: The simplest kind of weapon: a model and a handful of numbers. Everything not written here comes from the global config and the framework defaults.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: HK416A5
entries.description: A modern carbine, handed out with a red dot.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Honeybadger
entries.description: A rifle with a suppressor built in: quiet, no muzzle flash, short reach.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: KrissVector
entries.description: A very fast-firing submachine gun with little kick.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: LVOA
entries.description: A rifle with no iron sights, so it comes with a holographic sight and a laser.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: M1911
entries.description: A .45 service pistol. Eight rounds that hit hard.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: M203
entries.description: A grenade launcher. The round is a physical projectile: it leaves slowly, arcs under gravity and explodes on the first thing it touches.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: MP5
entries.description: A 9mm submachine gun: accurate and easy to control. Its magazine drops out on a reload.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: MP7
entries.description: A compact personal defence weapon. Its rounds go through light cover.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: P90
entries.description: A bullpup personal defence weapon with a fifty-round magazine on top.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Panzerfaust3
entries.description: A rocket launcher. One rocket that flies, drops a little and explodes on whatever it hits.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: PKM
entries.description: A belt-fed machine gun with a hundred-round box. Slow to move with, slow to reload, and it does not stop.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Prototype
entries.description: The kit called it "I have no idea what this is", so it got to be something nobody expects: it fires slow glowing rounds that bounce off walls three times before they give up.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Remington700
entries.description: A bolt-action rifle with the realism options on: the chambered round is tracked separately from the magazine, and every shot needs the bolt cycled before the next.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Remington870
entries.description: A pump-action shotgun: several pellets per shell, a pump between shots, and shells loaded one at a time. Firing interrupts the reload.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: SCARL
entries.description: A steady rifle at a measured rate of fire.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: SnipexTRex
entries.description: A single-shot 14.5mm rifle. It goes through nearly anything.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: SPAS12
entries.description: A pump-action shotgun. Pump between shots; shells load one at a time.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: SVD
entries.description: A semi-automatic marksman rifle with its own PSO-1 scope.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Uzi
entries.description: An open-bolt submachine gun: slow-firing for its class and loose from the hip.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Arcade
entries.description: Point and click. No reserve to manage, generous accuracy, gentle recoil, quick reloads and nothing to learn beyond aim, shoot and reload.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Realistic
entries.description: Everything on. The chamber is tracked, bolts and pumps are worked by hand, a dropped magazine takes its rounds with it, weapons can jam, and there is no crosshair or hitmarker to lean on. Hits are lethal.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Standard
entries.description: The framework defaults, unchanged. This preset exists so "the defaults" is something you can pick by name and copy as a starting point for your own.
entries.author: xerseer

entries.name: Tactical
entries.description: Slower and more deliberate. Hip fire is loose, aimed fire is rewarded, recoil has to be controlled, and an early reload keeps the round in the chamber.
entries.author: xerseer
